data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ali' meaning 'Night' and 'Ul' meaning 'Radiance'. This name signifies the one who radiates grace and beauty even in the darkest hours. The name Aliul carries the meaning “Night Radiance” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Aliul usually hope their child will grow to embody night radiance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
